papers.title: Spatiotemporal migration of antiferromagnetic domain walls in ${\mathrm{Sr}}_{2}{\mathrm{IrO}}_{4}$
papers.abstract: Author(s): Ian Robinson, David Yang, Ross Harder, Dina Sheyfer, Longlong Wu, Jack Griffiths, Emil Bozin, Mark P. M. Dean, Jialun Liu, Hengdi Zhao, Gang Cao, Angel Rodriguez-Fernandez, Jan-Etienne Pudell, Roman Shayduk, James Wrigley, Alexey Zozulya, Rustam Rysov, Aliaksandr Leonau, Ulrike Boesenberg, Joerg Hallmann, and Anders Madsen While laser-driven demagnetization and magnetic x-ray scattering in Sr2IrO4 are both well-established, the combination in a pump-probe experiment at an x-ray free electron laser is new. papers.title: Odd-parity altermagnetism: A spin group study
papers.abstract: Author(s): Minghuan Zeng, Zheng Qin, Ling Qin, Shiping Feng, Lin Wu, Dong-Hui Xu, and Rui Wang Conventional altermagnetism, characterized by the even-parity spin splitting, has been intensively studied. Here, on the basis of spin-group analyses, the authors elucidate necessary conditions for the emergence of odd-parity altermagnetism. It is derived that the odd-parity altermagnetism arises from the following criteria: (i) the breaking nonmagnetic time reversal symmetry; (ii) the collinear compensated magnetism; (iii) the symmetry [C2||E¯] connecting opposite-spin sublattices, where C2 and E¯ respectively represent a 180° rotation around the axis perpendicular to spins and the inversion separating opposite-spin sublattices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：基于自旋群分析（spin-group analyses）推导条件，属于理论框架研究。；研究对象：奇宇称交错磁（odd-parity altermagnetism）的对称性条件。具体为：在自旋群框架下，研究不同于传统偶宇称交错磁的奇宇称自旋劈裂现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 奇宇称交错磁的产生需同时满足三个必要条件：（i）破坏非磁性时间反演对称性；（ii）共线补偿磁性；（iii）存在连接相反自旋子晶格的对称性 [C2||E¯]，其中 C2 为垂直于自旋方向的180°旋转，E¯ 为分隔相反自旋子晶格的反演操作。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：奇宇称交错磁的产生需同时满足三个必要条件：（i）破坏非磁性时间反演对称性；（ii）共线补偿磁性；（iii）存在连接相反自旋子晶格的对称性 [C2||E¯]，其中 C2 为垂直于自旋方向的180°旋转，E¯ 为分隔相反自旋子晶格的反演操作。；创新点：首次从自旋群角度系统阐明奇宇称交错磁的对称性条件，区别于已被广泛研究的传统偶宇称交错磁。

papers.title: Controlled pairing symmetries in a Fermi-Hubbard ladder with band flattening
papers.abstract: The competition between interactions in systems with slow electrons can drive unusual collective behavior. Here, the authors study a microscopic ladder model featuring both diagonal hopping pathways and complex loop-like electron exchange interactions. They demonstrate that while both mechanisms independently suppress ordinary metallic behavior, they stabilize completely distinct spatial patterns of electron pairing. These findings offer a theoretical framework for engineering specific superconducting states by tuning the competition between pairing mechanisms in platforms like twisted bilayer graphene or cold atoms.

papers.title: Giant magnetoelasticity in FeRh thin films evidenced via strong phonon-magnon coupling
papers.abstract: Author(s): D. Ourdani, C. Gourdon, J. A. Arregi, V. Uhlíř, Y. Roussigné, and L. Thevenard FeRh is best known for its metamagnetic transition and giant volume magnetostriction. Here, the authors reveal remarkably strong phonon–magnon coupling in epitaxial FeRh. papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于复值逆温度和配分函数的新方法，利用热场动力学（TFD）来定量表征量子与热涨落，从而探测具有非平凡谱和动力学的量子物质相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于复值逆温度和配分函数的新方法，利用热场动力学（TFD）来定量表征量子与热涨落，从而探测具有非平凡谱和动力学的量子物质相。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据摘要内容，其创新点在于将热场动力学与复值温度下的配分函数零点分析相结合，为探测量子相提供了一种不同于传统方法的替代途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：热场动力学（TFD）。该方法通过引入复值逆温度，将配分函数的零点（即Fisher zeros）与量子相变和动力学行为联系起来。

papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未完整给出核心发现。根据已有信息，论文旨在探讨弯曲几何（“鼓的形状”）如何影响狄拉克型量子霍尔表面态的谱性质。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。从标题和摘要片段推断，创新点可能在于将“听鼓辨形”这一经典几何-谱对应问题推广到具有狄拉克锥能谱的量子霍尔表面态体系，并研究曲面几何对量子霍尔态的影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。摘要未明确说明具体理论框架（如是否使用连续模型、紧束缚模型或拓扑场论等），仅提及基于三维拓扑绝缘体纳米线在强磁场下的表面态这一物理体系。
